Wave A1–D3 already put modules on all 15 pages. The real gap is **image debt**: six services are still checklist/process/comparison only, with no `browserProof`, `proofGallery`, or `metricChart`. Treat the next wave as **Infographic + Proof Enrichment**, not another module-type invent pass.

---

## (A) Visual system rules

### Intent → visual job

| Service intent | Primary visual job | Default module stack (locked) |
|---|---|---|
| **PPC / media** | Prove control of spend and outcomes | `browserProof` → `metricChart` (Verified series only) → `comparisonTable` |
| **Listing / conversion** | Show listing craft and structure | `proofGallery` (listing/A+/infographic frames) → `processSteps` → `checklistMatrix` |
| **Creative / video** | Show craft quality, not stock lifestyle | `proofGallery` (real or AI showcase stills) → `processSteps` → `checklistMatrix` |
| **Ops / catalog / compliance** | Make invisible process visible | **AI system infographic** (new) + `processSteps` → `checklistMatrix` → `comparisonTable` |
| **Channels** (Shopify / TikTok / email) | Show complementary workflow, not Amazon replacement | `processSteps` + one visual proof (`proofGallery` or AI flow diagram) → `comparisonTable` |

### WHEN to generate a NEW AI image

Generate **only** when all three are true:
1. The page has no honest real crop for that concept (growth inventory miss, or ops/compliance has no screenshot).
2. The image teaches a **system** (flow, anatomy, before/after structure, channel map) — not a fake dashboard metric.
3. Caption language is honest: “Illustrative workflow” / “Conceptual diagram” — never presented as Seller Central or client ROI.

**AI image brief locks:** ink `#131311` + lime `#C6FD50` + hard chrome; Amazon-seller UI cues allowed as stylized chrome; **no purple gradients, no emoji icons, no fake ACoS/ROAS callouts, no competitor logos, no invented % badges.**

Save under `public/images/services/{slug}/`, log provenance in `docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md`.

### WHEN to reuse modules / UI chrome (do not generate)

- macOS browser chrome via existing `browserProof` / hub hero patterns
- Existing growth dashboards in `public/images/growth/`
- Existing creative stills in `public/images/creative/`
- Shared module components — extend only if a **new module type** is required (default: no)

### WHEN to use real case / growth proof crops

- Any numeric outcome (`metricChart`, dashboard captions)
- PPC, full-service, reporting, DSP (when asset exists)
- Prefer growth inventory + case-study footnotes over AI charts

**Never** AI-generate a chart that implies Verified metrics.

### Anti-patterns (replace first)

Replace in this order on every slug:
1. **Long `body` / `differ` paragraphs with no adjacent module** → insert the intent’s primary visual before or after `differ`
2. **Three text modules, zero images** (ops debt pattern) → add one AI system infographic **or** real proof crop
3. **Generic processSteps** that could sit on any service → rewrite steps to service-specific verbs
4. **proofGallery of unrelated creative stills** on non-creative pages → replace with intent-fit visuals or honest “demo context” captions, or remove
5. **Wall of FAQ + related services** with empty mid-page → fill mid-page first; FAQ is not the visual fix
6. **Invented ROI overlays on images** → delete; use Verified site stats only in copy

---

## (B) Per-service-type mapping

| Type | Slugs | Must have image? | Preferred source | Forbidden |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **PPC** | `amazon-ppc-management-agency`, `amazon-dsp-management` | Yes | Growth `browserProof`; Verified `metricChart` only if footnote exists | AI fake Ads console with numbers |
| **Full-service / reporting** | `full-service-amazon-agency`, `amazon-reporting-analytics` | Yes | Growth dashboards + GoSports Verified series | New ROI claims |
| **Listing** | `amazon-listing-optimization`, `amazon-content-writing` | Yes | Creative/listing stills; AI **listing anatomy** infographic if stills thin | Keyword-stuffing mock with fake ranks |
| **Creative** | `amazon-visual-creativity`, `amazon-video-creative` | Yes | Real showcase stills first; AI only to fill missing frame types | Stock lifestyle as “our shoot” |
| **Ops** | `amazon-catalog-management` | Yes (currently debt) | **AI catalog health diagram** + keep checklist/process | Fake suppression SLA timelines |
| **Compliance** | `amazon-trademark-brand-registry`, `amazon-company-registration` | Yes (debt) | **AI document/step infographic** | Legal outcome guarantees; “approved in X days” |
| **Sourcing** | `amazon-product-sourcing` | Yes (debt) | **AI sourcing evaluation flow** | Cost-cut % guarantees |
| **Channels** | `shopify-website-development`, `tiktok-shop-ads`, `email-retention-marketing` | Yes (debt / weak) | AI complementary-stack diagram; TikTok uses demo stills only if captioned honest | Amazon-replacement claims; invented GMV/ROI |

**Module count lock per page:** 3–4 mid-page modules. At least **one** must be image-bearing (`browserProof` | `proofGallery` | AI image inside `proofGallery`/`processSteps` hero slot | `metricChart`). Text-only triple stacks are not done.

---

## (C) Execution queue (highest visual debt first)

Debt score = no image module + ops/compliance abstraction + weak differentiation after Wave A1–D3.

| Order | ID | Slug | Why first |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | E1 | `amazon-catalog-management` | Text-only triple; core Amazon ops; high commercial relevance |
| 2 | E2 | `amazon-trademark-brand-registry` | Text-only; abstract compliance; needs system infographic |
| 3 | E3 | `amazon-company-registration` | Text-only; same debt class as E2 |
| 4 | E4 | `amazon-product-sourcing` | Text-only; flow diagram needed |
| 5 | E5 | `email-retention-marketing` | Text-only; Amazon email constraint must stay explicit |
| 6 | E6 | `shopify-website-development` | Text-only; complementary-store visual missing |
| 7 | E7 | `tiktok-shop-ads` | Has gallery but demo stills only — upgrade flow diagram + honest captions |
| 8 | E8 | `amazon-listing-optimization` | Has gallery — add listing-anatomy infographic if mid-page still feels flat |
| 9 | E9 | `amazon-content-writing` | Same as E8 for copy craft |
| 10 | E10 | `amazon-video-creative` | Stills-as-video-context — strengthen storyboard/placement visual |
| 11 | E11 | `amazon-visual-creativity` | Strongest gallery — polish only if static after compare |
| 12 | E12 | `amazon-dsp-management` | Has browserProof — add DSP vs Sponsored visual clarity if needed |
| 13 | E13 | `amazon-catalog` wait — skip; next is `full-service-amazon-agency` | Already image-rich — enrichment only |
| 14 | E14 | `amazon-ppc-management-agency` | Already strongest proof stack — last-mile polish |
| 15 | E15 | `amazon-reporting-analytics` | Already browserProof + metricChart — polish last |

## (D) Master CONTINUE prompt

```markdown
# SERVICES DETAIL — INFOGRAPHIC + PROOF ENRICHMENT (MASTER CONTINUE)

You are the executing agent for eCom Gliders service DETAIL page visual enrichment.
Project: custom Next.js site migrating https://ecomgliders.com/
Local: http://localhost:3000
Service URLs stay root `/{slug}/` (never move under `/services/{slug}/`).
Blog URLs must remain identical paths. Do not invent redirects.

## MISSION

Service pages already have hybrid mid-page modules from Wave A1–D3
(`browserProof`, `comparisonTable`, `processSteps`, `metricChart`, `proofGallery`, `checklistMatrix`).
User feedback: detail pages still feel too static / lack infographics.
This wave adds intent-fit visuals (real proof crops and/or AI system infographics) page by page.
Content JSON + Zod schema remain the source of truth. PO visual language: ink/lime/hard chrome.
No purple AI aesthetic. No emoji icons. Professional agency English.

## CONTINUE PROTOCOL

1. On every user message that is CONTINUE / APPROVE / NEXT: do exactly ONE slug from the queue.
2. Read before build:
   - `docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md`
   - `docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md`
   - `.cursor/prompts/SERVICES-VISUAL-CONTINUE.md` (prior wave context)
   - `content/config/services/{slug}.json`
   - `docs/research/GROWTH-PROOF-INVENTORY.md`
   - `docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md`
   - relevant `.cursor/rules` (00, 06, 08, 09, 12, 13) and skills: research, seo-audit, asset-management, competitive-research
3. Research + counsel BEFORE editing (same turn, but counsel first in notes/SESSION-STATE):
   - Load local page `/{slug}/` (Playwright)
   - State current modules and whether an image-bearing module exists (Verified/Observed)
   - Check growth inventory for a real crop fit
   - Decide: REUSE growth/creative asset vs GENERATE AI system infographic vs BOTH
   - Write a 5–8 line recipe: intent, modules kept/changed, asset plan, claims risk
4. Then implement that slug only.
5. Verify, log, update recipes + SESSION-STATE.
6. STOP. Do not start the next slug until the user says CONTINUE.
7. When the queue is fully COMPLETE, stop and report QUEUE COMPLETE. Do not invent more work.

## QUEUE (highest visual debt first — skip only if E-wave COMPLETE)

| Order | Slug |
|------:|------|
| 1 | amazon-catalog-management |
| 2 | amazon-trademark-brand-registry |
| 3 | amazon-company-registration |
| 4 | amazon-product-sourcing |
| 5 | email-retention-marketing |
| 6 | shopify-website-development |
| 7 | tiktok-shop-ads |
| 8 | amazon-listing-optimization |
| 9 | amazon-content-writing |
| 10 | amazon-video-creative |
| 11 | amazon-visual-creativity |
| 12 | amazon-dsp-management |
| 13 | full-service-amazon-agency |
| 14 | amazon-ppc-management-agency |
| 15 | amazon-reporting-analytics |

## VISUAL DECISION RULES (LOCKED)

### Intent mapping
- PPC / DSP / reporting / full-service: prefer real `browserProof` + Verified `metricChart` (footnote required). Do not AI-fake dashboards with numbers.
- Listing / content: `proofGallery` of listing craft; AI allowed for listing-anatomy / A+ structure infographic with honest caption.
- Creative / video: real showcase stills first; AI only to fill missing frame types; never claim AI stills are client photography or video files.
- Ops / catalog / compliance / sourcing: MUST add an image-bearing visual (AI system/process infographic is the default when no growth crop exists) plus keep process/checklist/comparison.
- Channels (Shopify / TikTok / email): complementary-stack or lifecycle diagram; keep “not a replacement for Amazon ads” where already established; no invented GMV/ROI.

### AI image generation rules
- Generate only when no honest real proof exists for the teaching job.
- Subject = system diagram / workflow / anatomy — not fake metrics.
- Style locks: ink #131311, lime #C6FD50, hard chrome, Satoshi-compatible UI feel; no purple, no glow maze, no emoji.
- Captions must say illustrative/conceptual when AI; never imply Seller Central screenshot or guaranteed results.
- Save to `public/images/services/{slug}/` with meaningful names; log `docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md` (source, date, license/tool, used-on page).
- Prefer Cursor GenerateImage (or project image tool). Validate visually after generation.

### Reuse rules
- Prefer `public/images/growth/` for numeric/dashboard proof.
- Prefer existing `public/images/creative/` for craft galleries.
- Reuse module renderers; do not invent a new module type unless the catalog cannot express the need — if inventing, document WHY in `docs/project/DECISIONS.md`.

### Anti-patterns to fix first on the active slug
1. Mid-page with zero images
2. Generic process steps reusable on any service
3. Unrelated creative stills on non-creative services without honest captions
4. Long text walls between hero and results with no module break
5. Any invented ROI, approval timeline, cost-cut %, or rank promise on image or copy

## CLAIMS AND EVIDENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Evidence language only: Verified / Observed / Assumed / Proposed / Requires confirmation / Not yet tested.
- Do not invent metrics, case results, ROAS, ACoS, GMV, approval rates, or cost savings.
- Allowed site claims only if already verified in repo/site: helping sellers since 2018; 20+ in-house professionals; 95% retention; $112M+ revenue managed — verify before reuse.
- Growth proof captions: keep factual; label as account-specific examples, not guarantees.
- Compliance pages: retain “not legal advice” / “no promise of approval” where present; do not weaken.

## IMPLEMENTATION SCOPE PER TURN

- Update `content/config/services/{slug}.json` modules (and copy only where needed for captions/headings).
- Add/replace image assets as decided.
- Touch shared components only if required for rendering the enrichment.
- Update `docs/seo/SITE-SEO-MAP.md` row only if title/meta/H1 meaningfully change (do not degrade SEO).
- Update `docs/project/SERVICE-LAYOUT-RECIPES.md` visual status for this slug (E-wave note).
- Update `docs/ai/SESSION-STATE.md` and append `docs/ai/CHAT-SUMMARIES.md` after material completion.
- Append `docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md`.

## VERIFICATION (REQUIRED BEFORE COMPLETE)

- Playwright desktop (~1440) + mobile (~390): modules visible, no overflow, form intact, no PO/competitor copy leak.
- Confirm at least one image-bearing mid-page module on the slug.
- Confirm no invented numeric claims on new visuals.
- Confirm URL still `/{slug}/`, canonical intact, H1 intact or improved with approval-level judgment (no silent SEO downgrade).
- Screenshot evidence for the new visual fold.

## DONE CRITERIA FOR ONE SLUG

- Counsel recipe recorded
- Image-bearing enrichment shipped
- Provenance logged (or explicit no-new-asset with justification)
- Verification log entry written
- Recipes + SESSION-STATE updated
- Agent STOPPED

## STATUS BLOCK (END EVERY TURN)

STATUS: <IN PROGRESS | COMPLETE | BLOCKED | QUEUE COMPLETE>
IMPLEMENTED: <slug + what changed>
VERIFIED: <checks + evidence language>
DOCUMENTED: <files updated>
REMAINING: <next queue slugs>
NEXT ACTION: CONTINUE → <next-slug> | QUEUE COMPLETE | APPROVE staging

## HARD STOPS

- One slug per CONTINUE.
- No staging/production deploy unless user says APPROVE.
- No blog URL changes.
- No service slug/path changes.
- No purple AI look, no emoji icons, no fake dashboards with numbers.
- When order 15 is COMPLETE, report QUEUE COMPLETE and stop.
```
